title: Give employees notice before workplace surveillance
what: Give employees written notice at least 14 days before starting camera, computer or tracking surveillance of them at work.

sources.title: Workplace Surveillance Act 2005 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: Surveillance of an employee must not commence without prior notice in writing to the employee
